/mkha' 'gro gsang 'dus kyi tshogs shin tu bsdus pa 'bum ther bsags skabs lta bur grangs gsogs bzhugs so/ /ram̐ yam̐ kham̐:oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥdabying

tei:div.tei:p: /mkha' 'gro gsang 'dus kyi tshogs shin tu bsdus pa 'bum ther bsags skabs lta bur grangs gsogs bzhugs so// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ dbyings dang ye shes gnas yul dur khrod nas/ /rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro rab 'byams tshogs/ /dur khrod ma mo spyang zhon mched sde 'bum/ /'dir gshegs longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chag mthol bshags gzung 'dzin dbyings su sgrol/ /lhag gtor bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: sarba dhā ki nī ma ma ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes pa'ang nye bar mkho phyir chos kyi blo gros pas so// //
